question: What is this entry trying to establish?
idea: The study of symmetry and reversible operations. A group records how operations combine, such as rotations of a shape. This entry studies the specific objects and conditions named in the source claim below.
why: The study of symmetry and reversible operations. A group records how operations combine, such as rotations of a shape.

glossary.meaning: A structure for combining reversible operations, such as rotations or symmetries.
A way of measuring the number of independent directions or degrees of freedom; different theories use different notions.

exactClaim: Constructs an infinite finitely presented residually finite group whose elements all have finite 2-power order, answering the finitely presented Burnside problem negatively even in this class. The construction also yields an infinite-dimensional finitely presented nil associative 𝔽2-algebra and a finitely presented infinite-dimensional algebraic unitization, giving negative answers to the corresponding nilpotence and Kurosh finiteness questions.
scope: A definition-led reading guide; the exact mathematical claim is preserved separately. This is not a proof assessment.
